UserTraffic.description: Cumulative traffic of one user since the counter epoch began. Never decreases.

user_id.description: Opaque, stable user identifier assigned by the service. Xray carries it as the client `email`, so traffic counters map back to it; it is never a person's name.
user_id.title: User Id

UserTraffic.title: UserTraffic

description:
Cumulative per-user traffic counters.

The agent folds Xray's resettable counters into a durable store, so totals
survive Xray and agent restarts. Each report carries the totals at one moment
and the next `seq`. The service keeps the last (counter_epoch, seq, totals)
per node and counts only the growth since then: a resent or older `seq` is
acknowledged without counting, so a flaky link never loses or double-counts
traffic. A new `counter_epoch` starts every user from zero. A user missing
from a report keeps its stored total; the agent may forget a removed user's
counter once a report holding its final total is acknowledged.

collected_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, ending in Z.
collected_at.title: Collected At

counter_epoch.description: Identity of the agent's traffic counter store: a lowercase UUID the agent draws when it creates the store. It changes only when the store is lost, which restarts every cumulative counter from zero.
counter_epoch.title: Counter Epoch

seq.description: Report number within `counter_epoch`, growing by one.
seq.title: Seq
